nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a square matrix over a commutative ring $R$ whose rows and columns are indexed by a finite set of size $N$, and write its characteristic polynomial as $\chi_A(X) = \det(X I - A) = X^N + c_1 X^{N-1} + \dots + c_N$. For a natural number $k$, the descending coefficient $c_k$ of $A$ is the coefficient of $X^{N-k}$ in $\chi_A$ when $k \le N$, and $0$ when $k > N$.
nodes.title: Characteristic-polynomial coefficients in descending order
